cateringServices.title: Espresso Bar
cateringServices.description: Full espresso setup from our solar-powered van or espresso cart. Lattes, cappuccinos, cortados — made to order on-site. No generator, no fumes, no noise.

cateringServices.title: Nitro Cold Brew On Tap
cateringServices.description: We bring the nitro kegs to you. Full tap service. It's the conversation starter at every event we've done.

cateringServices.title: Iced Espresso & Cold Drinks
cateringServices.description: Made with our Kyoto cold brew concentrate. It's the same smooth, low-acid profile as our nitro cold brew, in a form that scales for any size event.

nitroKegFeatures.title: Full Service
nitroKegFeatures.description: We serve offices, cafés, pop-ups, and venues across the Bay. If you want nitro on tap, we deliver, setup, and service the kegs.

nitroKegFeatures.title: Consistent Quality
nitroKegFeatures.description: We always seal our kegs with nitrogen and store at 38F, preserving flavor and extending shelf life far beyond a standard cold brew setup. What you pour on day one tastes like day one.

nitroKegFeatures.title: The Pour
nitroKegFeatures.description: The nitrogen creates a creamy head of foam that's both visual and textural. Our guests always remember it.

nitroProcessFeatures.title: Single-Origin Base
nitroProcessFeatures.description: Brewed from the same traceable, specialty-grade beans we use for our full roast lineup. No shortcuts.

nitroProcessFeatures.title: 18-Hour Cold Steep
nitroProcessFeatures.description: Our cold brew steeps for a full 18 hours at low temperature, extracting maximum flavor with zero bitterness.

nitroProcessFeatures.title: Nitrogen Infused
nitroProcessFeatures.description: Charged with nitrogen gas for a silky, cascading pour with a natural creaminess. No added sugar or additives.

sproWhyFeatures.title: Higher throughput. No new machines.
sproWhyFeatures.description: Every iced drink that waits for the espresso machine slows down the line. Our concentrate pulls it out of the equation — same quality, higher throughput, more happy customers.

sproWhyFeatures.title: Consistent shot quality. Every time.
sproWhyFeatures.description: Cold-extracting to espresso concentration makes it so every drink tastes the same. No dialing in. No variation between baristas, beans, or temperature changes.

sproWhyFeatures.title: Drinks all week.
sproWhyFeatures.description: Sealed and refrigerated, our concentrate holds its quality far longer than brewed espresso. Open it Monday, finish it Friday.

sproProcessFeatures.title: Single-Origin Base
sproProcessFeatures.description: Same traceable, specialty-grade beans we roast for the full lineup. We know where every bag comes from.

sproProcessFeatures.title: Cold Extraction
sproProcessFeatures.description: We extract cold and slow, pulling maximum flavor without the bitterness that heat introduces. The result is smooth, rounded, and complex.

sproProcessFeatures.title: Concentrated Craft
sproProcessFeatures.description: Packed at high strength so you control the dilution. Use it straight for a bold hit, or stretch it for lattes, cocktails, and batch service.
